cards.front: What is Control Hub?
cards.back: Cisco’s management console for one Webex organization: users, permissions, calling, meetings, messaging, and devices. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does it exist — what breaks without a single org console?
cards.back: Services, identities, and devices would be administered as separate products. The overview exists so an admin sees which services are actually provisioned before configuring them. [cite:1] [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What breaks if only one person holds full administrator?
cards.back: Cisco recommends more than one full administrator so the org stays operable. The partner’s administrator is the first full administrator and is expected to create more. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does an admin action work end to end?
cards.back: Sign in, change a user or location or device, and the org record is what later services read. Role grants can take up to 10 minutes. A device is not in the org until its activation code is used. [cite:2] [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do licenses sit relative to users?
cards.back: The Get Started article says the overview is where you view licenses across services and administer licenses to users. Organization-based and group-based license assignment are full-admin privileges in the role matrix. The SKU catalog is T1-R03. Read the strings on the subscription in Control Hub. They follow the order, and the role matrix only covers privileges. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Are locations only a calling idea?
cards.back: No. The locations article says you can use one location for both calling and workspaces, and that settings templates can apply to groups and locations. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What are the failure modes, and how do I prove which one?
cards.back: Prove it from the user role page, the group membership, the location caution icon, and the Devices state — not from the symptom sentence. The matrix in this room is the checklist.
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove a role conflict versus a delay?
cards.back: If Save was moments ago, the 10-minute window is still open. If the user already holds location admin or read-only, combination rules explain a refused or ignored grant. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove Calling is “missing” because of role, not because the subscription lacks Calling?
cards.back: Check the overview for whether Calling is provisioned [cite:1] , then check whether the signed-in admin is a device administrator or user and device administrator, who can’t administer Webex Calling. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does this admin model differ across Calling, WxCC, WxCCE, and Dedicated Instance?
cards.back: Control Hub remains the org console. Webex Calling configuration is a service inside it, and device-centric admins are explicitly blocked from administering Calling. [cite:2] Contact Center adds a Contact Center Service Administrator role; a customer full administrator can administer contact-center features, while a customer read-only administrator cannot access the Webex Contact Center administrative interfaces. [cite:2] WxCCE and Dedicated Instance Open Calling → Dedicated Instance for the private UC apps, or the
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is different about external contact-center admins?
cards.back: A partner full administrator can perform contact-center admin similar to a customer full admin, except they cannot add or revoke Contact Center Service Administrator from other external administrators. A read-only admin from a partner org can access contact-center admin interfaces in read-only mode; a customer read-only admin cannot access them at all. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: If I redesigned Control Hub roles, what would I change, and what stops me?
cards.back: I would want one location-scoped role that can also hold a narrow custom permission. The product constraint that stops me is explicit: location administrator cannot be combined with other roles, including custom roles. The supported escape hatch is a custom role that includes the needed view, not a stack of badges. [cite:2] [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What would I not automate?
cards.back: Role assignment via the administrator CSV. The article says you can’t manage administrator roles through that CSV. [cite:2] Read developer.webex.com for which roles the API can assign. Coverage changes when Cisco adds a role, so check that page before any script is trusted.
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A brand-new user in the organization can do what in Control Hub?
cards.back: B. Users you add have no administrative privileges at first. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which combination does the role article forbid?
cards.back: B. Location administrator is exclusive, including versus custom roles. More than one full admin is recommended. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A user-and-device administrator says Webex Calling settings are missing. The overview shows Calling is provisioned. What do you check before you open a TAC case?
cards.back: The role itself. User and device administrators and device administrators can’t administer Webex Calling. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: After you save a new role, the article allows access to lag up to:
cards.back: B. Up to 10 minutes. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: You assign a role to a Webex group, then remove Jordan from that group. What happens to the admin rights that came only from the group?
cards.back: Jordan loses those permissions. Group membership is the grant. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Redirect user support, when enabled, does not apply to:
cards.back: B. Organization administrators, as defined in the roles article. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: On paper, draw one organization containing overview, users, locations, services, devices, and org settings. Place Partner Hub outside the box. Then check the map in this room.
cards.back: The dashed frame in the map is the customer org. Partner Hub manages orgs; it is not a folder inside one org. [cite:2] [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A caution beside a calling location most directly means:
cards.back: B. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: You need a person who can see almost everything but also export the admin audit log, and they must not be a full admin. Which documented direction do you take?
cards.back: Read-only cannot be combined with a custom role. Create a custom role that includes the access required, including the audit-log style permission if it is in the custom-role catalog. Confirm the permission exists in the UI. Security activity administrator is the prebuilt role tied to the admin actions audit log in the matrix. [cite:2] [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: The functional role “Webex Calling Detailed Call History API access” is:
cards.back: B. [cite:2] re-check after that date.
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A customer read-only administrator cannot open contact-center administration, but a partner read-only administrator can open it read-only. Is that a contradiction?
cards.back: No. The contact-center role table documents those two rows differently. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: In one sentence: what is a workspace, and how is a device bound to the org?
cards.back: A workspace is a place (room, desk, lobby) that can hold devices and services. Control Hub issues an activation code that is entered on the device to link it. [cite:3] [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R01-control-hub-foundations.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is Directory Connector?
cards.back: Windows software from Control Hub that synchronizes one Active Directory domain into the Webex organization. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does a dry run exist?
cards.back: The guide says you must do a dry run before a full synchronization. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What breaks if SSO is skipped and invites are suppressed?
cards.back: Invite suppression requires the SSO integration, so the suppression step is not available as a standalone switch. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does an organization SSO assertion name the user?
cards.back: The IdP claim includes the uid attribute, and NameID format is transient. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does partner SSO differ?
cards.back: The claim is mail, rather than uid. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which SCIM generation synchronizes groups and still skips rooms?
cards.back: SCIM 2.0. Rooms and avatars are Wizard-only, through Microsoft Graph. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long is the manual SCIM bearer token valid?
cards.back: 365 days. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why would SAML JIT create fail while Directory Connector is healthy?
cards.back: If Directory Sync or Entra ID is enabled, SAML JIT create or update will not work. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What proves a second IdP is configured and still unused?
cards.back: Control Hub can add the IdP and leave it inactive until a routing rule exists. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where does the Calling routing prefix belong?
cards.back: In the location dialing settings, not already inside the Directory Connector extension. T2-R03 cites that rule. [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can this identity move to another GEO later?
cards.back: The residency article says Webex does not currently support migrating between GEO locations. The country choice permanently sets the GEO for users and encryption keys. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R02-identity-directory-sync.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does an automatic license assignment do?
cards.back: It grants the selected Webex licenses to new users without a manual assignment for each person. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When can the person use the service?
cards.back: When they become Active, at first sign-in, unless verified domains, SSO, and suppressed invites already made that possible. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why would a template ignore a brand-new user?
cards.back: A specific license was assigned at creation. API and CSV follow the same rule. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which subscription is used first?
cards.back: The oldest, until its licenses are used, then the next oldest. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the union rule?
cards.back: Organization and group templates combine. A license added by one and removed by the other is still received. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Do nested groups inherit?
cards.back: No. The assignment applies to direct members. The hierarchy is flat. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Preserve licenses protect?
cards.back: Licenses already on existing users when you remove them from the assignment. Clear it to remove those licenses, including manually assigned ones. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which Contact Center license wins a group collision?
cards.back: The Premium agent license. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why can Calling stay off after the template is correct?
cards.back: The user needs a location and an extension or number. Auto-assign looks up an E.164 work number that is pre-provisioned and free. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a professional workspace upgrade refuse afterward?
cards.back: A downgrade to the common area workspace license, including when you switch subscriptions. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is lost on a professional-to-standard user downgrade?
cards.back: All provisioning and configuration information for the affected users. The article says to treat that as a last resort. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which Calling client versions lose Calling services?
cards.back: Webex Calling versions 44.3 or earlier. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R03-licensing-subscriptions.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is a location?
cards.back: A physical address that organizes users and workspaces, and can hold calling and workspace management together. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who generates the Location ID?
cards.back: Webex, when you create the location. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why can’t a Calling location be deleted immediately?
cards.back: You click Disable calling first. Calling users and workspaces also need the Calling license removed. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a manual add from the location allow?
cards.back: Up to 25 users, or a CSV. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is required on a floor?
cards.back: The floor number. The name is optional. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which API replaced the previous calling locations API?
cards.back: /v1/locations . Floors are on the workspace-locations API. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the -CALL suffix mean?
cards.back: A migrated calling location whose name collided. Duplicate names are not allowed. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why would changing the location time zone leave the auto attendant alone?
cards.back: The auto attendant, hunt group, and call queue take the location time zone at creation, and that feature time zone cannot be altered afterward. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When does location membership change licenses?
cards.back: When an organization template exists and preserve license is off. Group templates, CSV, and the API are excluded. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you move a Calling workspace?
cards.back: Remove the Calling license, move the workspace, then entitle Calling again. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do territory-specific numbers fail?
cards.back: When Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, or the U.S. Virgin Islands is given the United States as the country. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R04-locations-sites.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who becomes full administrator on first setup?
cards.back: The administrator from the partner organization. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is location administrator exclusive?
cards.back: The role article says you can’t assign any other administrator role to a location administrator, and a full administrator can’t hold it at the same time. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long can a new role take?
cards.back: Up to 10 minutes. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who can assign roles to users?
cards.back: The matrix marks full administrator as yes, and read-only as read-only. User and device administrators can assign the location administrator role and cannot assign other administrator roles. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who sees the admin actions audit log?
cards.back: Full administrator and security activity administrator. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many groups can carry admin roles?
cards.back: Up to 100. One group can have up to 20 roles. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the location scale for a Calling administrator?
cards.back: Up to 250 assigned locations. The drop-down in one save is up to five. One location can receive up to 5 administrators at a time. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can a location administrator add a hunt-group agent from another site?
cards.back: They can delete any assigned agent, including agents from other locations, and they can add new users only from their assigned locations. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can a customer read-only administrator open Contact Center admin?
cards.back: No. The table says they cannot access the Webex Contact Center administrative interfaces. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What replaces the obsolete Calling CDR role?
cards.back: A custom role for the Detailed Call History CDR APIs, including stream and feed. The old role remains operational until December 31, 2026. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can the administrator CSV change roles?
cards.back: No. You can’t manage administrator roles through the CSV file. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R05-admin-roles-partner.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do you open Webex Calling troubleshooting?
cards.back: Control Hub, Monitoring → Troubleshooting. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How far back does that view go?
cards.back: 21 days. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is a call segment for?
cards.back: Each segment can succeed, fail, or be refused on its own, so a transfer is not one blob. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What path-optimization values does the article list?
cards.back: ICE, PNC, and No optimization. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many troubleshooting records fit in one CSV?
cards.back: 100. And only the tab you are viewing. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why did filters vanish?
cards.back: The search was a phone number or a correlation ID. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the difference between 13 months and a 3-month picker?
cards.back: Pro Pack keeps 13 months. Starting January 27, 2026 the article says you select at most 3 months at a time. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the worst-experience click do?
cards.back: Opens Troubleshooting for that user’s media sessions in the chosen dates, up to 21 days. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you collect Webex App logs?
cards.back: Troubleshooting → Logs, search the email, Collect logs, then Collect. [cite:3]

cards.back: 30 days. The user can send them from the app. An offline user cannot be collected. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can you bill from Analytics?
cards.back: No. The article says the data is for general use and should not be used for billing. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: Pro Pack gets 13 months, and others 3 months, for calls based in Webex App. Read the dashboard you actually opened before you repeat it. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R06-analytics-troubleshooting.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: The GEO for the organization’s users and encryption keys, plus organization identity and encrypted user-generated content. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do you read Meetings and Messaging residency?
cards.back: Account > Info > Data Locations. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can you move the org to another GEO later?
cards.back: The article says Webex does not currently support migrating between GEO locations. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which Messaging regions does the FAQ name?
cards.back: Europe, hosted in Frankfurt and Amsterdam, and North America and the rest of the world, hosted in the United States. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do EU-city Meetings go?
cards.back: Frankfurt. Other time zones use the closest data center. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What sets Calling residency?
cards.back: The data center closest to the principal place of business the partner provided at order time. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who owns a group space?

cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where is a cross-org 1:1 stored if one user is in North America or RoW?
cards.back: In the North America or rest-of-world GEO. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long can you search the audit log?
cards.back: The past year. Retention is 12 months in most regions and three years in India. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where is AI-generated content stored?
cards.back: In the same data center as the user-generated content. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: B3 is the country. B4 is the region. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Does compliance stop at the region border?
cards.back: The article says compliance officers continue to have visibility of user content regardless of where it is stored. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T1-R07-data-residency-security.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Webex Calling mean in the migration guide?
cards.back: The multi-tenant cloud call service. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: Control Hub at admin.webex.com. re-check [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: Desk, Room, and Board devices, IP phones, and Jabber. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What do the Expressway pairs do in that picture?
cards.back: Mobile and remote access, and business-to-business. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the local gateway bridge?
cards.back: PSTN for cloud-registered endpoints, and calls between Unified CM-registered and cloud-registered endpoints. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which cloud PSTN options need no on-premises equipment?
cards.back: Cisco Calling Plan and Cloud Connect for Webex Calling. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where does a trunk terminate?
cards.back: On a local gateway or another supported device. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who does cloud PSTN serve?
cards.back: Webex Calling users. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which directory tool does the guide name for Entra ID?
cards.back: The Entra ID Wizard, instead of Directory Connector. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which location details does the migration section list?
cards.back: Emergency response address, number of users, internet access, and PSTN access. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Name one reason the guide gives for keeping call control on premises.
cards.back: Phone models Webex Calling does not support, complex on-premises integrations, a complex dial plan or highly granular class of service, restrictive or unreliable internet, stringent data privacy, on-premises or in-country recording, a third-party integration without a Webex Calling alternative, or a contact-center integration that is not moving yet. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is the March 20, 2025 workflow marked?
cards.back: That header is older than 12 months, so its feature list is re-check until the article is read again. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R01-calling-architecture.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is a Local Gateway?
cards.back: The premises SBC that terminates a Webex Calling trunk so a location can use premises-based PSTN or reach a non-cloud site. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does it exist?
cards.back: Cisco PSTN and Cloud Connected PSTN replace the carrier in the cloud. Local Gateway exists when you keep your carrier, your analog, or a PBX next door. Without it, that location has no documented premises PSTN path. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What breaks if I also expect phones to register to it?
cards.back: You will troubleshoot the wrong box. Endpoints register to Webex Calling. The gateway is a trunk, not a proxy registrar. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does a premises call work end to end?
cards.back: Carrier ↔ LGW ↔ TLS/SRTP ↔ Webex Calling ↔ endpoint. The location’s numbers and route selection decide whether step three has anywhere to go. [cite:4] [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is different on a certificate trunk?
cards.back: Trust is the FQDN in the certificate, not a digest password. SIP from the LGW carries that FQDN in Contact. OPTIONS drive the online status in Control Hub. [cite:2] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do route groups sit?
cards.back: In Control Hub, with trunks and dial plans. A trunk that is not selected as the location’s premises PSTN does not carry that location’s calls just because the CUBE is up. [cite:2] [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove which failure I have?
cards.back: Four evidence piles: Control Hub trunk status, location number list, CUBE registration or TLS/OPTIONS, and whether the endpoint is registered in Control Hub. Audio failures are a fifth pile (RTP), after signaling succeeds.
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove a scale miss versus a bug?
cards.back: If the trunk is registration-based, the documented ceiling is 250 concurrent calls and max-conn should not be set above 250. Crossing that is a design miss. [cite:3] [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove a certificate identity miss?
cards.back: Read the CN/SAN and the Control Hub FQDN as strings. They must match. Wildcards are unsupported. Public DNS must resolve the name. [cite:2] [cite:10] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does this differ across Calling, WxCC, WxCCE, and Dedicated Instance?
cards.back: This room is multi-tenant Webex Calling. Contact-center voice can ride Webex Calling PSTN services even without a Calling subscription for the contact-center order itself — that claim belongs to the WxCC architecture article and is taught in T3-R01. [cite:12] Dedicated Instance has its own Local Gateway patterns and, for DI-to-multi-tenant contact-center support, help says certificate-based trunks are required because registration-based trunks are no longer supported on that interop. [cite:13] WxCCE PSTN is not thi
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is Survivability Gateway just a second name for LGW?
cards.back: No. BRKCOL-2312 treats SGW as the outage path for endpoints when the cloud is unreachable, managed from Control Hub, and lists co-location constraints that include provisioning the gateway as Survivability Gateway rather than as Local Gateway. Detail is T2-R07. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: If I redesigned PSTN attachment, what would I change?
cards.back: I would want one trunk type so labs stop splitting digest and certificates. The constraint is scale and device support: registration is the simple CUBE model at 250 calls, and certificate exists because that model does not scale. The partner-hosted article says certificate trunking was created to solve registration’s scale limits. [cite:8] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What would I refuse to hard-code?
cards.back: Firewall ports from a 2024 Cisco Live slide are replaced by b2exve as of 2026-10-14. The country list from the undated at-a-glance PDF stays marked in the limits table. [cite:21] against current help before a build. [cite:9] [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many PSTN options can one location use at a time?
cards.back: One. Mix across locations, not inside one. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Registration-based Local Gateway concurrent calls, per trunk:
cards.back: Up to 250. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Registration-based trunks support which SBC?
cards.back: CUBE only. Third-party SBCs are a certificate-trunk conversation, and only if Control Hub lists them. [cite:3] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A designer sends phones to the Local Gateway’s registrar “so the branch survives.” What is wrong in the steady state?
cards.back: Endpoints register to Webex Calling, not through the LGW. Survivability is a different gateway service. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Wildcard certificates on a certificate-based LGW are:
cards.back: Not supported. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Control Hub shows a certificate trunk offline. Signaling config “looks right.” What transaction does the getting-started article single out?
cards.back: OPTIONS from the Local Gateway. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Webex-facing media and signaling in the IOS-XE guide are:
cards.back: SIP/TLS and SRTP. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Draw three locations: Austin on Cisco Calling Plan, Berlin on CCP, Denver on LGW. Show phones registering to the cloud in all three.
cards.back: Only Denver’s PSTN hairpins through an SBC. All endpoints still register to Webex Calling. [cite:1] [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Cisco PSTN does not appear for a location that already used a Local Gateway. Name two documented reasons besides “the UI is broken.”
cards.back: Pre-existing locations that already had another PSTN capability are not eligible in the article’s conditions, and Cisco PSTN may be unavailable after another option was assigned. Also check committed OCP, country, and data center. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: For a registration trunk, max-conn should be:
cards.back: 250 or lower. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why was certificate-based trunking created, according to the partner-hosted gateway article?
cards.back: To solve the scale limitations of the registration-based model. [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Someone pastes TCP 5062 and UDP 19560–65535 into a firewall request and cites “Cisco Live.” What do you do?
cards.back: Recognize BRKCOL-2812 (2024), mark it re-check, and open b2exve (retrieved 2026-10-14) before you build an ACL. [cite:21] the current port reference before the change window. [cite:9]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R02-local-gateway-pstn.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the default extension length?
cards.back: 4 digits, and the allowed range is 2–10. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What three PSTN choices can a location have?
cards.back: Cisco PSTN, Cloud Connected PSTN, or premises-based PSTN. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who can place a call through cloud PSTN?
cards.back: Webex Calling users. Premises-originated calls cannot. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is an ESN?
cards.back: Location routing prefix plus extension, used when inter-location extension dialing is disabled. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many trunks can a route group hold?
cards.back: 1 to 10. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does priority level 1 on two trunks mean?
cards.back: Calls are distributed randomly across them. Trunk 3 at level 2 is the fallback when a level-1 trunk is unavailable. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where may ! appear?
cards.back: Once, at the end, and only on an E.164 pattern. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Does *.example.com match example.com?
cards.back: No. It matches hosts that are subdomains, such as eu.example.com. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why would incoming PSTN be treated as a local premises call?
cards.back: Extension length was increased and the provider is not sending E.164. Enforce E.164 first. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Verify Call Routing show beyond the pattern?
cards.back: Outgoing permissions, fraud prevention, digit patterns, intercept, and translation. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is partition order the tie-break here?
cards.back: No. That is the CUCM CSS rule in T6-R02. This room’s engine is the Webex pattern language. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which export label is misspelled in the article?
cards.back: Export Dial Patters CSV. Quote it that way. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R03-dial-plans-pstn-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What two claims does Control Hub offer?
cards.back: MAC address, or an activation code. A blank MAC generates the code. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long is the code?
cards.back: 16 digits. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long does an MPP code last?
cards.back: 30 days. A Room device code lasts 7 days. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which firmware can type the code?
cards.back: MPP firmware 11.3.1 SR2 or later. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many devices on a professional workspace?
cards.back: Up to five of the phone types the article names. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the default calling service for a Room or Desk workspace?
cards.back: Call on Webex, which is 1:1 and non-PSTN. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which CSV device types cover RoomOS?
cards.back: WEBEX or WEBEX_CALLING. IP is for MPP, ATA, and DECT. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What must you set on an ATA before activation?
cards.back: Network settings, including VLAN, IP address, and subnet mask. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who may generate a code?
cards.back: Only specific roles. The article points at the organization-role article rather than listing them. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens to an online MPP when its workspace is deleted?
cards.back: The phone is deleted and factory-reset, and it returns to the activation-code screen. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When can a Board and a Room Series device share a workspace?
cards.back: Companion Mode. A standalone Room Navigator can also be added beside other devices. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R04-devices-provisioning.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where are these features created?
cards.back: Services > Calling > Features. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the simultaneous hunt-group cap?
cards.back: 50 agents. Weighted is 100. Circular, Top Down, and Longest Idle are 1,000. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is hunt group busy on by default?
cards.back: No. An administrator turns it on. Agents use FAC codes only if they are allowed. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What license includes Call Queue?
cards.back: The Webex Calling professional license. The offering is voice-only. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What queue size does the article warn against?
cards.back: Zero. Incoming calls are not allowed. The maximum in the table is 250. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which skill level is highest?
cards.back: 1. Level 20 is the lowest. The default is 1. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can you change an auto attendant’s location?
cards.back: No. The article says you cannot change it after creation. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the default no-input timer?
cards.back: 10 seconds. The CSV range is 1–60. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many pickup groups can a user join?
cards.back: One, and the group is a single location. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What do you dial to park and to retrieve?
cards.back: *68 to park after hold and a dial tone. *88 to retrieve. # parks or retrieves against your own extension. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why might India agents not see the hunt-group caller ID?
cards.back: The hunt group’s location and the agent’s location must share PSTN provider, country, and zone. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the 50-agent sentence on a queue?
cards.back: A recommendation for voice queues. The maximum table still lists 1,000, 100, or 50 by pattern. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R05-call-features.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which TLS versions does jwkbt2 list?
cards.back: TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which SRTP suite does that article list?
cards.back: AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is Calling E2EE on by default?
cards.back: No. Turn on Enable end-end encryption when making calls. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does opportunistic mean?
cards.back: Start on SRTP, upgrade when clients can, downgrade if the service must process media. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Name three call types that do not get Calling E2EE.
cards.back: 1:1 PSTN, 1:1 premises trunk, conference mixer. Also recording, auto attendant, voice portal, shared or virtual lines. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does recording do to E2EE?
cards.back: Disables it. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the recording article say is the default?
cards.back: Both Webex and Dubber, in different sentences. Webex retention is one year and 100 GB. Dubber Go is 30 days. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which RedSky hosts and port?
cards.back: api.wxc.e911cloud.com and wxc.e911cloud.com, port 443. b2exve does not name TCP on that row. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is 933?
cards.back: 933 on the Calling notification test, nj0abhbb header September 24, 2025, checks emergency-call email generation in the United States and Canada without alerting public safety personnel. [cite:6] nvfbjts says place 933 calls, then activate Emergency call routing. [cite:5] Read nvfbjts for whether that WxCC test reaches a PSAP. The article does not say.
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is a WxCC agent identified in RedSky?
cards.back: Device User Id equal to the agent email, then myE911. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is edge port 5061 not the trunk port?
cards.back: jwkbt2’s SRV example is endpoint discovery. Trunk destinations in b2exve are 5062 and 8934. [cite:1] [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R06-calling-security-compliance.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Are zero-trust meetings the same as Calling E2EE?
cards.back: No. Meetings use MLS. Calling E2EE is the opportunistic SRTP upgrade, and escalation into a meeting ends the Calling session. [cite:2]

cards.back: To the Webex cloud. [cite:1]

cards.front: Where do they register in Survivability mode?
cards.back: To the local Survivability Gateway. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long must the cloud path be back?
cards.back: At least 30 seconds. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: IOS XE Dublin 17.12.3. Hunt group, call forward, and auto attendant start at 17.18.2. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What certificate types are refused?
cards.back: Private or enterprise CAs, and wildcard certificates. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What hunt-group cap applies in this mode?

cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Webex App support during the outage?
cards.back: Internal extensions, PSTN in and out, outgoing emergency, hold and resume, transfer, inbound caller ID, and shared call appearance. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens to a live Webex Calling call when the site switches?
cards.back: That call is terminated. A call that is up when the outage ends continues. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do five shared DNs on five phones count?
cards.back: As 25 toward max-dn. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can a third-party phone use the gateway?
cards.back: Third-party devices are not supported. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T2-R07-survivability-gateway.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What history does Calling analytics keep for Webex App calls?
cards.back: 13 months with Pro Pack. 3 months without. [cite:1]

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T2-R08-calling-analytics-cdr.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is Webex Contact Center in this track?
cards.back: Cisco’s cloud CCaaS contact center: entry points, flows, queues, teams, and Agent Desktop, provisioned from Control Hub. The Canon calls it multi-tenant because Cisco Live does. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is it a separate product from Webex Calling queues?
cards.back: Calling queues are a calling feature. This platform answers the call in a flow, queues across sites, mixes digital channels through Connect, and builds Analyzer datasets from service events. [cite:1] A side-by-side of queue math is T7-R06, not a guess in this answer.
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What breaks if I design it as “UCCE in the cloud”?
cards.back: You will look for Router, Logger, and CVP. Those names belong to the Enterprise / on-prem heritage track. This article’s nouns are entry point, flow, queue, team, site. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does a voice contact move?
cards.back: Number → entry point → flow instance → queue → team → the phone number the agent registered at login. Events branch off to Analyzer. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the flow do if no agent is free?
cards.back: The contact parks on the queue and the treatment attached to the queueing activity continues until an agent is offered the contact and the handler is interrupted. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where does chat enter?
cards.back: Webex Connect, not the PSTN edge. Connect can bot-treat the thread and must explicitly queue it into Webex Contact Center. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove a routing failure?
cards.back: Check entry-point match, flow reached Queue Contact, team is in the active distribution group, agent skills if the queue is skill-based, and the login station is dialable. Profile scope explains “I cannot see it,” which is not the same as “it did not route.”
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove the login station?
cards.back: Call the number the agent typed, from outside the queue. The article says an invalid number means the agent cannot receive incoming calls. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do I prove I am in the wrong admin UI?
cards.back: If the task is “create a queue” and you are in a legacy portal module the setup guide itself retired, switch to Contact Center → Customer experience → Queues and re-check. [cite:8] [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Do I need a Webex Calling subscription to land a PSTN call on WxCC?
cards.back: The architecture article says calls route in using Webex Calling PSTN services and that this allows routing to the contact center without a Webex Calling subscription. It also says all new Webex Contact Center subscriptions include those PSTN services automatically. [cite:1] Read the PSTN choice on the subscription and on the location in Control Hub. The architecture article says new subscriptions can include Webex Calling PSTN, and the SKU follows the order.
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: If I redesigned the object model, what would I change?
cards.back: I would want queues to be site-scoped so a supervisor grant could not forget a global queue. The article’s constraint is that queues and entry points are global at organization level; site scoping is done with user profiles and by creating separate queues per geography. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What would I not copy into a sizing spreadsheet?
cards.back: The 300 / 6000 / 10500 figures from the setup guide, and the 400 / 48,000 phrases from the 2025 deck, until each is verified against a current limit document. [cite:4] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: B. CCaaS, cloud native, services on Kubernetes in AWS. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: A site. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Chat is not reaching agents. Where do you look first?
cards.back: Webex Connect: the asset, the Connect flow, and whether it queues into WxCC. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: An agent is Available in the right team and the queue never offers. You call their login number and it fails. Diagnosis?

cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: B. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: B. And the role must be Administrator or Supervisor. [cite:9]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A colleague says new contact-center orders cannot receive PSTN calls unless the customer also buys Webex Calling. What does the architecture article actually say?
cards.back: Calls route using Webex Calling PSTN services, which can land on the contact center without a Webex Calling subscription, and new WxCC subscriptions include those PSTN services automatically. Confirm the order’s SKU separately. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R01-wxcc-multitenant-overview.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does an entry point represent for a phone call?
cards.back: The number the call arrives on. The flow tied to that entry point through a routing strategy handles it. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is a queue?
cards.back: Where the contact waits until an eligible agent is selected or picks it up. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which patterns can a non-skill team queue use?
cards.back: The routing article lists Longest Available for that queue type. The queue article says Longest Available is the default. [cite:2] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which patterns can a non-skill agent-assignment queue use?
cards.back: Longest Available, Circular, and Linear/Top-down. Circular is the default. There is no timed target expansion. [cite:2] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When is Best Available a choice?
cards.back: Skill-based queues. It ranks agents who fully meet the requirements by proficiency score. [cite:2] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does a call distribution group expand?
cards.back: The contact searches the first group. If nobody matches, it parks for the configured duration, then the next group’s teams are added. A later free agent in an earlier group can still be chosen. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Check Agent Availability change?
cards.back: An empty current group is skipped immediately, from the Queue Contact activity. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is top-down different from circular?
cards.back: Top-down always starts at the beginning of the ordered list. Circular resumes after the last selected agent. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a less-than-or-equal skill do to a Best Available score?
cards.back: That skill’s value is inverted: 10 minus the actual value. Only proficiency skills enter the score. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why would a variable queue not honor Best Available?
cards.back: The flow article says you cannot enter skill requirements on a variable queue, and the contact is routed Longest Available, overriding the queue algorithm. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where is the flow chosen for WhatsApp or email?

cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is the Labs Erlang number the product’s estimated wait?

cards.source: Canon room T3-R03-entry-points-queues-routing.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R04-agent-desktop-supervisor.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R04-agent-desktop-supervisor.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is a capacity-based team for?

cards.source: Canon room T3-R04-agent-desktop-supervisor.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Do skill-profile edits force a new sign-in?

cards.source: Canon room T3-R04-agent-desktop-supervisor.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T3-R04-agent-desktop-supervisor.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: The design requires two independent physical networks so a single failure does not look like both a dead component and a dead path. A simultaneous failure of both is called catastrophic. [cite:1]

cards.front: What sets the call-processing node count?

cards.front: How many end users can be in the cluster?

cards.front: When is SME eligible, and whose network carries SME replication?

cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is MRA on day one versus the entitlement?

cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who can use the nightly backups?

cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens if the location has no main number?
cards.back: Users cannot make or receive calls through the route group associated with that location. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why do inbound B2B calls fail on a new Expressway-E?
cards.back: A call policy blocks all inbound B2B calls until you update it for valid sources. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do you go for the two-link peering rule?
cards.back: T5-R02. This room defines the add-on. Connectivity choices are T5-R03. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T5-R01-what-dedicated-instance-is.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What do you buy before you can activate Dedicated Instance?
cards.back: The optional add-on. Activation is not available as a substitute for the purchase. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which UC applications does the activation article say it deploys?
cards.back: Unified CM, Unity Connection, Expressway Core and Edge, and Emergency Responder only in AMER. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can you move a live region to another region later?
cards.back: No. The activation article says it cannot be reversed or moved. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens to the voice service domain on the second region?
cards.back: The domain from the first activation applies to later regions in that org, and the UC applications domain cannot be edited after submit or activate. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is EMEA not a choice for a new customer?
cards.back: The activation article says there are no new Dedicated Instance deployments in EMEA. Choose EU or UK. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do you open the UC applications?
cards.back: Calling → Dedicated Instance → Manage → UC application. Cross-launch works before peering is done. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many Edge Connect links does Dedicated Instance require?
cards.back: Two. The redundancy option is mandatory on that order, and the practice article calls two links a must. [cite:3] [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What ASN does Edge Connect publish for Webex?
cards.back: 13445. Retrieved again on 2026-10-14, the location table still prints 13445 on most rows and 399937 on Melbourne. Both prints stay. [cite:3] [cite:6]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What prefix do you use on the BGP peering link itself?
cards.back: A public /30 or /31. That is the link subnet, not the UC application /25. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does a private ASN prepend fail?
cards.back: Webex strips the private ASN after ingress. Use the local-preference communities instead. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How can one sentence say a single Edge Connect 3.0 path and another require two DI links?
cards.back: ny65x1bb describes consolidating services on the Edge Connect 3.0 capability, including a single peer used for DI and WxCCE in that customer story. n68tcpb and tf6kpq still require two Dedicated Instance connections to two data centers. Quote both. Do not delete either. [cite:5] [cite:3] [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What must a CM group contain?
cards.back: The deployment guidelines say a CM group must include Unified CM nodes from both data centers in the region, and that you should not start the CallManager service on the publisher. [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R02-di-architecture-peering.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: Partner Connect, Virtual Connect, and Edge Connect. [cite:1] [cite:2] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What must already be true before a Partner Connect or Virtual Connect request?

cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What are the two Partner Connect bandwidth pairs?
cards.back: Direct is 1 G or 10 G. Fabric is 200 MB to 10 GB. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is Virtual Connect’s combined ceiling equal to one tunnel?
cards.back: Failover puts all traffic on the remaining tunnel, and that tunnel is 250 Mbps. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the CPE advertise on Virtual Connect?
cards.back: A default route on each tunnel. Cisco advertises a /25 per data center. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which Control Hub role activates Virtual Connect?
cards.back: Customer Full admin. Read-only admin can view status. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is Webex’s public BGP ASN, and what prefix length is the peering link?
cards.back: 13445. A public /30 or /31. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which community is the most desirable Edge Connect path?
cards.back: 13445:900. The set runs from 13445:200 through 13445:900. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can Partner Connect carry Meetings without Dedicated Instance?
cards.back: No. The article says it cannot be leveraged for Webex Calling and Meetings without the Dedicated Instance add-on. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you hold both Edge Connect 3.0 sentences at once?
cards.back: One peering capability can carry multi-tenant, Dedicated Instance, and Meetings. Cisco still requires two sites in the region. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens to a private ASN on Edge Connect?
cards.back: Webex strips it after ingress. AS-path prepending is not supported. Use link-priority communities. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which numbers are you forbidden to treat as the same ceiling?
cards.back: 250 Mbps is Virtual Connect. 1 G or 10 G and 200 MB to 10 GB are Partner Connect. Edge Connect does not reuse the 250 Mbps sentence. [cite:1] [cite:2] [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: A. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Both Virtual Connect tunnels are up and each is carrying 200 Mbps. What does the failure rule say?
cards.back: Combined traffic must not exceed 250 Mbps, because failover puts everything on one tunnel. This design is over the ceiling. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Cisco’s Virtual Connect private ASN range is:
cards.back: A. 13445 is the Webex public ASN on Edge Connect. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: A. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: Two sites in the region. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: A. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: A. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R03-connectivity-options.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: One /24, split into two /25s, one advertised per data center. CPE sends a default route on each tunnel. [cite:2]

cards.back: A. [cite:3]
