cards.front: What does Dedicated Instance operations decide first?
cards.back: Which RACI column owns the activity: customer, partner, or Cisco. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What breaks if the partner column is empty?
cards.back: Nothing in the matrix moves to Cisco. The customer assumes the partner responsibilities. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why advertise a default route?
cards.back: The Dedicated Instance side does not accept more specific routes than 0.0.0.0/0 from the customer. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where is a Day-1 request opened?
cards.back: Calling → Dedicated Instance → Service Request. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who may restart a service?
cards.back: The customer or partner, after they inform Cisco. TAC cannot. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove a fault is Cisco’s?
cards.back: Show it is a non-configuration issue on 100 percent of a UC cluster, or across clusters. Smaller configuration faults stay with the customer or partner, while cluster restore stays with Cisco in both rows. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What evidence shows a maintenance window was announced?
cards.back: Written notice at least 10 calendar days ahead for work that disrupts calling, sent to partners enrolled for Maintenance and outages. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is certificate ownership different from multi-tenant Calling?
cards.back: On Dedicated Instance, Cisco manages UC application certificates and rejects custom SANs. A UCM Cloud conversion keeps customer-managed certificates until the domain and CA transfer. This room does not restate multi-tenant trunk certificates. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who owns CCP numbers versus the CCP link?
cards.back: Customer or partner owns procurement and configuration. Cisco owns connectivity to the Cloud Connected PSTN provider. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why will you not use DRS as the rollback for a dial-plan change?
cards.back: The RACI says Cisco does not do on-demand restores and does not allow a restore as a change backout. Partners also have no DRS access. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which n-1 sentence do you teach?
cards.back: Both, until you re-read them. October 09, 2026 RACI allows n-1 of the deployed applications and names v15SU4a, with a security exception. The partner operations table prints v14.0 as n-1 and v15.0-SU4a as n, then says that n-1 is end of support. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the TAC technology pair?
cards.back: Collaboration and Conferencing, then UCM Cloud / Dedicated Instance (DI). High severity is a 60-minute response target. Call frontline for P1 and P2. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R04-di-admin-operations.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What connects Dedicated Instance to multi-tenant calling?
cards.back: Certificate-based SIP trunks over the Webex backbone, created at activation. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is activation not enough for a test call?
cards.back: You still incorporate the elements into both dial plans, and the default location needs a PSTN connection and a main number. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which prefixes do you protect?
cards.back: WXC-DI on multi-tenant and xWxC on Dedicated Instance Unified CM. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many interop trunks does the base article describe in a region?
cards.back: One to each Dedicated Instance data center. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove a registration trunk is still in the path?
cards.back: The route pattern or route list still targets it. The fix is the certificate route group. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What header identifies the cluster on the Webex Calling side?
cards.back: X-DI-WxC-otg, added by the normalization script. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is this different from a Unified CM to multi-tenant migration coexistence?
cards.back: That path uses a local gateway between on-premises Unified CM and Webex Calling. This path is Dedicated Instance already in the cloud, with Cisco’s certificate trunks. T6-R07 is the on-premises coexistence room. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can one person be a calling user on both?
cards.back: No. The deployment-model article says not both. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why might you still migrate everyone to Dedicated Instance before you split?
cards.back: The same article says Dedicated Instance can come first, and then you divide the user base. Contiguous numbers and group features stay together when you divide. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When do you reorder codecs?
cards.back: The contact-center integration says to reorder only for WxCC. The interop article already limits Dedicated Instance-directed calls to those three codecs. Do not treat the two sentences as one procedure. [cite:4] [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a missing main number block?
cards.back: Make and receive through the route group for that default location. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does SSO sit in a dial-plan room?
cards.back: Because Dedicated Instance user sync from Control Hub is unsupported without it, so the split never becomes real on the cluster. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R05-di-webex-calling-coexistence.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the Dedicated Instance migration sequence?
cards.back: Seven gates, ending in Transfer to Day 2. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does the assistant exist if it does not migrate?
cards.back: It assesses readiness and compares clusters so a certified provider tool can do the move. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which gates have no production impact?
cards.back: Project Initiation, Discovery and Assessment, and Planning. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long is freeze, and how long is cutover?
cards.back: Freeze is a recommended 2–3 weeks. The assistant cutover window should not exceed ten hours. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove phones moved?
cards.back: They are registered on Dedicated Instance. The assistant also has a post-registration report. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What DHCP change does the practice article name?
cards.back: Option 150, then a reset from the on-premises call manager. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is this different from the multi-tenant Unified CM tool?
cards.back: That tool imports a tar and builds Webex Calling users. This assistant compares clusters and schedules a Dedicated Instance cutover. T6-R03 is the other tool. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Does the seven-gate article migrate a third-party PBX by itself?
cards.back: It names third-party PBX as a source the method has covered. It does not print the object map. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is rollback not a restore?
cards.back: The practice article says rollback mirrors the cutover steps and must finish inside the maintenance window. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What would you refuse to add to the test list?
cards.back: A recorder cutover step these articles do not print. That stays TODO-verify . [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When can you open the network questionnaire?
cards.back: After Setup Assist approves the source readiness report and you agree. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T5-R06-di-migration-path.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the 2,000?
cards.back: A scenario size for this exercise. Not a Cisco limit.
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is this runbook a Cisco document?
cards.back: No. It is marked Canon planning.
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do Calling moves start?
cards.back: The Unified CM migration introduction, T6-R02. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you size the trunk?
cards.back: From concurrent calls, using t9xctu Table 5 as of 2026-10-14. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can a CUCM phone use cloud PSTN?
cards.back: No. Premises-originated calls cannot. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does not import?
cards.back: ICM scripts, CVP applications, skill groups, CUIC, Finesse gadgets. See T6-R04. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What do you build beside the old estate?
cards.back: Entry points, flows, queues, and teams. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When do WebRTC agents go live?
cards.back: After 933 and Emergency call routing. [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens if you also want E2EE?
cards.back: Recording disables it. Decide first. [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many numbers move in a step?
cards.back: One, after that flow answers. Canon planning.
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What stays up for reports?
cards.back: CUIC, until a human comparison is written down.
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the rollback?
cards.back: The old route was not removed. Send the number back. Canon planning, not a Cisco command.
cards.source: Canon room T6-R01-enterprise-cutover-capstone.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the introduction forbid as a method?
cards.back: A lift-and-shift of the current Unified CM deployment. Redefine requirements. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does PPDIO stand for in this guide?
cards.back: Prepare, Plan, Design, Implement, Optimize. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When are users split across both platforms?
cards.back: During a phased move, until everyone has transitioned. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which three places need dial-plan updates for each group?
cards.back: Unified CM, Webex Calling, and the Local Gateways. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Webex Calling do with a Unified CM extension it cannot see?
cards.back: It sends the call to the Local Gateway, along with other unmatched destinations such as PSTN numbers. [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does the configuration workflow describe Unified CM numbering?
cards.back: The Unified CM dial plan normalizes numbers as +E.164. [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who should use dual-step Jabber migration?
cards.back: Larger customers. Step 1 moves Jabber to the Webex App while the app still registers to Unified CM. Step 2 moves calling. Single-step is the small-population option. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What batching does Cisco recommend, and what overrides it?
cards.back: Physical sites or departments together. Feature dependencies such as a shared hunt pilot, call queue, shared line, pickup, or call park can force a tighter batch. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which 8800 models are not eligible for MPP?
cards.back: 8821 and 8831. 8832NR can migrate with a feature caveat. V15 and later need at least 11.3.3 MPP and cannot downgrade. [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do you import a Unified CM .tar?
cards.back: Control Hub → Services → Upgrades & Migrations → Migration Insights, then Step 3 Migrate to Webex Calling → Start New Task. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Name two reasons the introduction gives for considering staying on premises.
cards.back: Any two from the printed list. A complex dial plan or highly granular classes of service is one. A contact center that is not moving yet is another. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What will you not claim about CSS order?
cards.back: An evaluation algorithm. It is not in these articles. The labs explorer is a teaching model. Read closest-match on the Unified CM that still routes the call. The labs explorer is a teaching model, and it is not the order that cluster uses. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: The introduction’s instruction about the current Unified CM design is:
cards.back: B. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Each group transition requires routing updates on:
cards.back: C. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A 200-person site still on Jabber wants the smallest blast radius. Which option does the plan article recommend for larger customers?
cards.back: Dual step. Webex App registers to Unified CM first. Calling moves in step 2. Single step is described for a small number of users. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: 8821 and 8831 are:
cards.back: B. [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Webex Calling’s treatment of a Unified CM extension it cannot see is:
cards.back: B. [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: You want to migrate people alphabetically and a hunt pilot has members in three letters. What does the implement article push you toward?
cards.back: Keep users who share the hunt pilot together. Sites or departments are the recommended unit when dependencies allow. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Migration Insights import of Unified CM data uses:
cards.back: A. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: do_not_move_phone is documented as:
cards.back: B. [cite:9]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Draw Unified CM, the Local Gateway, and Webex Calling. Mark unmatched calls moving toward the gateway.
cards.back: That is the configuration-workflow picture: unmatched PSTN numbers and unseen Unified CM extensions go to the gateway, and the gateway routes between the two. [cite:8]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: A complex dial plan or highly granular class of service is:
cards.back: B. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Phase 2 has not finished and someone wants the Unified CM publisher powered off tonight. What does the plan article say?
cards.back: On-premises UC comes out after all users, soft clients, and devices have moved. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: The main number of a location can be assigned to:
cards.back: B. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R02-cucm-to-webex-calling.html quiz. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What are the three migration families in the December 2025 guide?
cards.back: Control Hub tools, certified migration providers, and Webex Setup Assist. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why run Insights before a task?
cards.back: The group CSVs show shared lines and hunt, queue, park, and pickup relationships that should move together. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the user-task cap?
cards.back: 1,000 users and 1,000 devices, and a task name of at least 8 characters. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which licenses can that task assign to a user?
cards.back: Calling professional or CX Essentials. Not Standard. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove the phone job was aimed correctly?
cards.back: Unified CM target is Phone and the transaction is Update Phone - Custom File. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why would pickup be missing after a successful feature import?
cards.back: The feature tool does not currently support CallPickupgroup.csv. The Python script creates it. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is this different from the Dedicated Instance assistant?
cards.back: That assistant assesses and schedules. It does not migrate. These tiles import a tar into multi-tenant Webex Calling, and two of the articles also say their steps apply to Dedicated Instance. [cite:5] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which phones never become MPP in the firmware article?
cards.back: 8821 and 8831. 8832NR can, with limitations. V15 and later need 11.3.3 and cannot downgrade. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why keep the call-park sentences from contradicting each other?
cards.back: The overview lists call park as mapped. The script section says the tool does not currently support the park and pickup CSVs and that the script creates them. Quote both. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What will you not claim about a third-party PBX?
cards.back: That these tar tools ingest it. That crosswalk is TODO-verify and lives in T6-R05. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does A-FLEX-P-CALL buy you, in that article?
cards.back: Temporary licensing for up to 18 months while both calling environments are in use. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When are both number buttons grey?
cards.back: When the task mixes premises PSTN locations with cloud or Cisco PSTN locations. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R03-migration-tools.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which article migrates Unified CCX?
cards.back: 0hd75db. It is a discovery tool plus Control Hub bulk import. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which article upgrades Webex Contact Center 1.0?
cards.back: nb2ve0e. Three stages, from Contact Center > Settings. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which article copies a Webex CCE portal?
cards.back: n2puc5z. Portal data between tenants, including a POD move and a UCCE upgrade case. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does flag 1 do on the CCE tool?
cards.back: It replaces that class on the target. Routing controls of all types are deleted first. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Does the CCE tool copy wav files?
cards.back: No. It copies audio groups, prompts, languages, and versions. An engineer copies the files. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the CCX CSV row cap?
cards.back: 5000 rows per file. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why are 1.0 routing strategies recreated?
cards.back: The article says legacy strategies are incompatible and are not copied. You create them with flow scripts. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can a 1.0 agent sit on both desktops?
cards.back: No. Agents cannot simultaneously access both desktops. When they move, set Contact Center Enabled to False on the legacy platform and True on the new one. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does Webex CCE Bulk Request do with peripherals?
cards.back: It migrates agents from one peripheral to another, by person or by team, and identifies skill groups. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is a UCCE dialed number an entry point?
cards.back: The 1.0 article moves a DN–EP pair inside Webex Contact Center. A UCCE dialed number has no published equivalence here. The row stays marked. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do ICM scripts go?
cards.back: Nowhere in these articles. Flow Designer is built beside the old estate. That is the Canon method, not a Cisco import.
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What will you refuse to say in an interview?
cards.back: That CUIC is Analyzer, that Finesse is Agent Desktop, or that the calling migration’s batch rule moves a script. [cite:5] [cite:6]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R04-ucce-pcce-to-wxcc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does this room decide first?
cards.back: Whether Cisco printed a procedure, or only named the source. Third-party PBX is named. The object map is not. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What file does Migration Insights read?
cards.back: A Unified CM tar. DeviceEligibility.csv then flags third-party devices among others. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who configures a third-party phone that has no firmware conversion?
cards.back: You provision it in Control Hub, and the implement article says to work with the vendor. [cite:2] [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which agent endpoints does the voice-channel article list?
cards.back: Webex PSTN, Webex Calling devices, Webex App, a premises PBX, and Microsoft Teams. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is +E.164 mandatory on a dial number?
cards.back: It is typical. It is not mandatory. The number must be reachable. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove a Teams agent design is the supported one?
cards.back: Show a registration or certificate Local Gateway, CUBE or a third-party SBC, +E.164 on that gateway, and no direct PSTN-to-Teams hop. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What evidence shows UCCX can stay on premises?
cards.back: Round-trip time under 60 ms to the Unified CM that owns call control. The article warns that AMER customer premises often miss it. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How is this different from T6-R04?
cards.back: T6-R04 is UCCE and PCCE into Webex Contact Center. This room is the third-party and UCCX-beside-Dedicated-Instance path those pages actually print. Do not import a fifth queue name. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which trunk type does Dedicated Instance use toward Webex Contact Center?
cards.back: Certificate-based. Registration-based trunks are no longer supported for that inter-op. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why will you not draw an Avaya station-to-Webex user table?
cards.back: No cited page prints it. The cell stays TODO-verify. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What will you not copy from the CUBE PDF into this room?
cards.back: The voice-channel article points at the PDF and says detailed SBC steps are not in the article. This room stops at that pointer. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where do third-party calling products get catalogued?
cards.back: The deployment guide sends you to the Webex App Hub calling collection. That is a catalog, not a migration procedure. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R05-third-party-pbx-cc.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is a port?
cards.back: A transfer from the losing carrier to the winning carrier. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What two documents prove you may port?
cards.back: A bill from the last 30 days and an LOA or eLOA. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How many numbers does one license allow?
cards.back: One. The port count cannot exceed purchased licenses. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When is the requested date real?
cards.back: When the losing carrier returns an FOC. Until then it is a request. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What happens to numbers on the same account?
cards.back: They port together, even if they were typed on different orders. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove you can still edit the order?
cards.back: FOC has not arrived. After FOC, Control Hub edits stop and PTS is the path. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What evidence shows a port-out was ignored?
cards.back: One business day passed on PSTN & Routing → PSTN Orders. The article says the request is then accepted automatically. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why are there two menus?
cards.back: Port-in support is Calling → PSTN → Orders. Port-out processing is PSTN & Routing → PSTN Orders. The articles print both. Do not collapse them. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a US port not move?
cards.back: Messaging. Get Started says only Calling services port in the United States and Canada. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which order-type cell will you not “fix”?
cards.back: Complex is headed “Any of the following” and starts with “> 1 TN,” while Standard is 1–50 TNs. Quote both. Do not invent precedence. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What day count will you not invent?
cards.back: How long “a reasonable period” is before unported numbers are released after Calling Plan cancellation. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When may you cancel the losing carrier?
cards.back: After the port completes and you have verified it. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R06-number-porting-cutover.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a phased migration do to the user population?
cards.back: It splits users across Unified CM and Webex Calling until the move finishes. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the difference between single-step and dual-step?
cards.back: Single-step moves the soft client and the calling service together. Dual-step moves the soft client first. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does the Webex Calling partition exist on Unified CM?
cards.back: So +E.164 destinations that live on Webex Calling have route patterns, and so you can build a class of service that reaches them. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which calling search space must not see that partition?
cards.back: The inbound calling search space on the trunk from the Local Gateway. That is the loop avoidance rule. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long is a Webex Calling extension?
cards.back: One global length. Control Hub allows any value between two and ten. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When does abbreviated inter-site extension dialing work?
cards.back: Only when the dialed extension is unique. Overlaps need a steering digit and site code. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Can a call queue have members on both platforms?
cards.back: q0pgpb says you cannot split shared services across the Local Gateway connection. Move the dependent users together. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Who can use cloud PSTN?
cards.back: Webex Calling users. Calls originating from premises users cannot access cloud PSTN. [cite:6]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How does a route group choose a trunk?
cards.back: Same priority is random load balancing. If those trunks are unavailable, a lower priority is tried. Maximum 10 trunks. [cite:6]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What must the Dedicated Instance interop location have?
cards.back: A PSTN connection and a main number. Otherwise users cannot place or receive calls through that location’s route group. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does ofrt6u change for older registration-based interop?
cards.back: Relink the route list and dial plan to the route group on the certificate-based trunk. The article’s example moves xWxC_ _RL to xWxC_MT_ _RG. [cite:7]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why keep contiguous numbers on one call control?
cards.back: ny65x1bb says that simplifies dial plan and routing when you split multi-tenant and Dedicated Instance. Group features are not fully harmonized. [cite:5]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R07-coexistence-interop.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What do you test first?
cards.back: A representative pilot that includes voicemail, attendants, queues, and hunts, using the same tools as the full move. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does a number check include?
cards.back: Extension, external number, on-net, PSTN, and overlaps. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Is the acceptance list complete?
cards.back: The article says it is not exhaustive. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which queue phrase belongs in this room?
cards.back: Round robin, longest idle, or simultaneous ring, as examples of configured Calling queue logic. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is Unified CM’s job after every user has moved and PSTN is still local?
cards.back: Transit between the PSTN gateways and Webex Calling through the Local Gateway. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you prove a Cloud Connect cutover was sequenced?
cards.back: A test location was validated and deprovisioned, all trunk numbers ported together, then every location was switched and tested both ways. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When is there no extra PSTN step?
cards.back: When hybrid trunking was used from the start. The remaining work is decommissioning Unified CM and the Local Gateways. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which DNS names do you remove, and from where?
cards.back: cisco_uds._tcp and cup_login._tcp on premises. collab_edge._tls in public DNS. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why a hidden partition?
cards.back: So calling search spaces prefer the cloud path of the same directory numbers. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which report names will you not recite here?
cards.back: The Dedicated Instance post-migration and post-registration reports. Those belong to T5-R06. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What voicemail promise will you not make?
cards.back: That Unity Connection messages and greetings moved natively. The guide says they do not. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Where is the call-troubleshooting procedure?
cards.back: The guide points at Troubleshoot Webex Calling calls in Control Hub, article frj1efb. This room does not reprint it. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T6-R08-post-migration-validation.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What secures the Local Gateway trunk to Webex Calling?
cards.back: SIP TLS for signaling and SRTP for media. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which cipher does commercial Webex Calling get in the article’s crypto class?
cards.back: AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. The article says Webex Calling only supports SHA1_80. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is different for Webex for Government?
cards.back: Certificate-based, CUBE only, and GCM (AEAD_AES_256_GCM) instead of the SHA1_80 step. [cite:1] [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is max-conn 250 on the sample Webex dial-peer?
cards.back: Registration trunks max out at 250 concurrent calls. The article says the configured maximum should be 250. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is BAD.BAD?
cards.back: A dummy destination-pattern required when an inbound dial-peer group routes the outbound leg. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why does a certificate trunk need OPTIONS?
cards.back: Control Hub uses those OPTIONS transactions, with the FQDN in Contact, to show the gateway online. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What is the inbound SIP match order?
cards.back: URI via, URI request, URI to, URI from, called number, calling number, then destination-pattern on the ANI. First matching criterion wins. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does dial-peer hunt 0 do?
cards.back: Longest match, then the lower preference number, then random. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Which debug does the routing article name for a hunting failure?
cards.back: debug voip ccapi inout. show dial-peer voice summary shows the hunt. debug voip uri is also printed for URI matches. [cite:3]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What does the Local Gateway article want in place before debugs?
cards.back: Diagnostic signatures, including DS 64224, which disables debugs at 75 percent CPU. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What will Config Validation refuse to judge?
cards.back: The PSTN and on-prem PBX dial plan. It is registration-based Local Gateway config only. [cite:4]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: Why is a recorded call a bad ICE example?
cards.back: The article says media that needs a cloud service such as recording cannot be optimized. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R01-sip-fundamentals-webex.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What two codecs does voice class codec 100 list first?
cards.back: g711ulaw, then g711alaw. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.back: translation-profile outgoing on the outbound dial-peer. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How long may the incoming translation-profile name be?
cards.back: Thirty-one characters. [cite:2]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: What command proves a rule?
cards.back: test voice translation-rule. [cite:2]

cards.back: It disables all debugs and uninstalls diagnostic signatures. [cite:1]
cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: When may you add a codec?

cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.source: Canon room T7-R02-cube-deep-dive.html ladder. Citations stay in that room.

cards.front: How do you tell CCPP media from Local Gateway media?
